statement: RetroArch1.20.0 Debian udev joypad receives changing core buttons and Nunchuk axes/buttons from both UHID and uinput in an original no-content diagnostic core. All8 accel/gyro activation requests return false; held owned FDs at4/8seconds are core and Nunchuk only. Installed1.20.0 source has no udev joypad sensor callbacks, unlike the newer surveyed RXYZ fallback; that branch is not blamed. Generic mapping passes only for these bindings and profiles; no gyro or complete printed-label acceptance.

applicability.revision: virtualgamepad840db277; installed version-pinned Linux consumers; physical revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. W7 bounded local virtual-host results; explicit uinput comparison in RetroArch arm. Survey source expectations are not host passes. No physical, calibrated, radio or whole-controller promotion.
